How it works

Three steps, no queues to work out on your own.

  1. 01

    Send it, or bring it in

    WhatsApp a clear photo or scan of your document, or walk into the office in Hor Al Anz. You get the typing fee before any work starts — government fees are quoted separately at cost.

  2. 02

    We type and check

    Forms are prepared in Arabic and English to the receiving authority’s format, then checked line by line for the small errors that get applications returned.

  3. 03

    Submitted, with the receipt

    We submit through the right channel — GDRFA/Amer, ICP, MOHRE/Tawjeeh, DET or the municipality — and hand you the receipt and reference number.

Common questions

If your question is not here, send it on WhatsApp with the document type. You will get the form, the fee and the list of papers in one reply.

Talk to us
What does a typing centre actually do?

It prepares and submits official forms — visa, Emirates ID, labour, licensing and attestation — in the exact format each authority requires. You bring the documents; the centre does the data entry, the Arabic/English wording, the compliance check and the submission.

Do I have to visit in person?

For typing and most submissions, no. Send clear photos or scans on WhatsApp and we confirm the form, the fee and the documents. Originals are only needed where the authority requires them — notarisation, biometrics, or MOFA.

How much does it cost?

The typing fee depends on the form and how many pages it runs to. You get that figure before we start, and government fees are quoted separately at cost, with the receipt. There is no charge for asking.

How long will it take?

Most single forms are typed while you wait. Multi-step transactions — attestation, a new licence, medical — depend on the authority and get a realistic range up front rather than a promise.

What should I bring?

Passport copy, current visa or entry permit, and any sponsor or company documents that apply. For Emirates ID renewals, the existing card. Message us first and we will confirm the exact list so you only make one trip.

Are you licensed, and which authorities do you deal with?

Qaaf is licensed by Dubai DET under trade licence 1529320. We prepare and submit for GDRFA/Amer (residency), ICP (Emirates ID), MOHRE/Tawjeeh (labour), DET and municipality (licensing), and MOFA (attestation).

Tell us what you need typed

Send the document type on WhatsApp and you will get the exact form, the turnaround and a quote — usually within the hour during opening times.

No payment to get a quote. Government fees are always quoted separately.
